summary: Slow server start leaves a permanently black window. main.js:789-795 gives up after a hardcoded 5000ms and creates the window anyway; loadURL is refused with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED and no did-fail-load handler exists, so it never retries. Server bound ~11.6s after launch and was healthy the whole time. No user-accessible recovery - Ctrl+R is not bound in the production build. Found on the Linux desktop during MPI-391 section D; never seen before because every prior test machine bound the port in under 5s.

Fix landed: did-fail-load handler on mainWindow.webContents retries the main-frame loadURL every 500ms (cap 60, skips ERR_ABORTED) until the server answers. The 5000ms fallback is deliberately unchanged - raising it is the symptom patch. Race is INTERMITTENT: cold start reproduced it, warm restart painted normally.

LIVE-VERIFIED on Linux. Cold page cache (sync + drop_caches) reproduced the race: server bound 13.5s after launch, the 5000ms fallback fired, 8 ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED retries were logged and then stopped - retry 9 succeeded. User confirmed the window painted and the app started normally; gpu-detect and the update check ran after, both renderer-driven. Pre-fix this exact sequence ended in a permanently black window. NOTE the first launch after extracting did NOT trip it (warm page cache, server bound in 0.8s) - a warm-cache launch cannot test this card.
doing -> done (complete). Live-verified on Linux 2026-07-30 (cold-cache repro: server bound 13.5s, fallback fired, retry 9 landed).
